test_title: PYST 25: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'FACES’ is written as 'AFCSE' and 'JEANS' is written as 'EJASN'. How will 'HANGS' be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

'FACES’ is written as 'AFCSE'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/670d711ac4173a6d927ce70015df23b0b714447735563d8e27973b99eaac60f3.png] 

'JEANS' is written as 'EJASN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca7a6237d8fe40d6046b8b0d8b1466f18fdf94e44ef40f3404f31cc58c4dcbd3.png] 

Similarly, for 'HANGS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d56108d4ff40dd2a6aa545e03a399d4edfcae77a8f903616b42edaed25374b7c.png] 

So, 'HANGS' will be written as 'AHNSG'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
